data.one_liner: A bottom navigation bar with a unique water drop effect marking the selected item.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customized bottom navigation bar widget featuring an animated water drop effect when switching between 2 to 4 items. It handles active and inactive icon states, custom background colors, and bottom padding adjustments.
use_when: You need a bottom navigation bar with 2 to 4 items
You want a custom animated water drop effect for selected navigation items
avoid_when: You need more than 4 navigation items
You require platform-native bottom navigation bars like CupertinoTabBar or BottomNavigationBar
strengths: Unique and polished water drop animation effect
Easy to integrate into Scaffold as a bottomNavigationBar
weaknesses: Limited to a minimum of 2 and maximum of 4 items
Fixed bar height due to vertical animation constraints
